scripts.podman-clean: sudo podman rm -f particles && sudo podman images | grep particles | awk '{print $3}' | xargs -r sudo podman rmi
scripts.podman-run: sudo podman run -d -p 4000:80 --restart always --name particles particles
scripts.podman-update: npm run podman-clean && npm run podman-build && npm run podman-run
